basic_profile.bio: A 32-year-old theater enthusiast and philosophy aficionado living in Orlando, Florida. By day, I work as a freelance writer focusing on performance arts critiques and reviews. In my downtime, I'm an avid reader of Eastern philosophies, especially Taoism, and I'm exploring its principles through literature and practice. I'm single, enjoy attending live theater performances, and catch most Orlando Magic games either in person or on TV. Online mostly during late evenings, as I spend my days either writing or attending local theater productions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Literature and have developed a keen interest in philosophy over the years. My knowledge in Taoism is largely self-taught, through reading foundational texts and engaging with online communities and discussions. I also have a solid understanding of theater arts, having been involved in various roles from stage management to critique writing.
